nvitk.gui.sge.retrieve
======================

.. py:module:: nvitk.gui.sge.retrieve

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Download GUI SGE results from the cluster and import into Napari.

.. py:class:: SgeRetrieveResult

   Outcome of downloading (and optionally importing/cleaning up) a completed SGE job's results.


   .. py:attribute:: remote_job_root
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: local_dir
      :type:  pathlib.Path


   .. py:attribute:: downloaded_files
      :type:  list[pathlib.Path]


   .. py:attribute:: done
      :type:  nvitk.gui.sge.models.SgeDoneMarker


   .. py:attribute:: imported_layers
      :type:  int


   .. py:attribute:: remote_deleted
      :type:  bool


.. py:class:: SgeManualImportDialog(parent=None, *, host='', user='', password='', remote_job_root='')

   Bases: :py:obj:`qtpy.QtWidgets.QDialog`


   Fallback when session credentials are missing (e.g. after GUI restart).


   .. py:attribute:: host


   .. py:attribute:: user


   .. py:attribute:: password


   .. py:attribute:: remote_job_root


   .. py:method:: _try_accept() -> None

      Validate that host/username/remote job root are filled in before accepting the dialog.



   .. py:method:: connection() -> nvitk.gui.sge.models.SgeConnection

      Build an :class:`~nvitk.gui.sge.models.SgeConnection` from the current form fields.



   .. py:method:: remote_root() -> str

      The entered remote job root, stripped and without a trailing slash.



.. py:function:: retrieve_sge_results(*, connection: nvitk.gui.sge.models.SgeConnection, remote_job_root: str) -> SgeRetrieveResult

   Download verified outputs from *remote_job_root* (must have ``output/.done``).


.. py:function:: import_sge_results_to_viewer(viewer: Any, result: SgeRetrieveResult, *, on_layers_changed=None) -> SgeRetrieveResult

   Open every file in *result.downloaded_files* into *viewer*, then return a copy of *result* with
   ``imported_layers`` updated; calls *on_layers_changed* afterward if given.


.. py:function:: import_sge_job(viewer: Any, app_state: dict[str, Any], *, job_id=None, parent=None, on_layers_changed=None, auto_delete_remote: bool = False, manual_fallback: bool = False) -> bool

   Download + import using session credentials from the current GUI session.
